newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity fund flows dip in 3-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity fund flows dip in 3-day period - survey.

text.p: Cash flows into U.S. stock mutual funds fell to $350 million for the three-day period ended January 16 versus $1.3 billion for the two-day period ended January 13, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

The fund tracking firm said that international funds dropped to $90 million for the period ended January 16 versus $376 million for the period ended January 13. Aggressive growth funds recorded outflows of $57 million versus inflows of $353 million.

Growth funds had outflows of $19 million versus inflows of $536 million. Growth and income funds posted gains to inflows of $509 million versus inflows of $413 million. Equity income funds had inflows of $39 million versus inflows of $155 million.

Bond funds posted sharply higher inflows of $533 million versus inflows of $65 million. Government/GNMA funds had inflows of $297 million versus outflows of $27 million. Muni funds had inflows of $291 million versus outflows of $20 million.
The firm said that large amounts were shuffled between several Vanguard funds "in what could be an institutional reallocation program."
